login.title: Sign in to your studio
login.blurb: For photographers with a saycheeeeeze account.

errors.invalid: That email and password don't match an account.
errors.noAccess: This login isn't connected to a studio yet.
errors.rate: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.unavailable: Sign-in isn't available right now. Try again in a moment.

newGallery.title: New gallery
newGallery.albumHint: For the portfolio. Everyone can see it once it is published.
newGallery.clientHint: A private delivery. Opens with a passkey.
newGallery.name: Title
newGallery.addressHint: Lowercase Latin letters, digits and hyphens. It can't be changed later.
newGallery.categoryHint: The filter it appears under on the Portfolio page.
newGallery.codeHint: The code your client types to open the gallery. Keep this one or type your own, at least 6 characters. Leave it empty to add one later.
newGallery.note: It starts unpublished. Nobody sees it until you publish it.
newGallery.createdBlurb: Save the passkey now. It is shown only this once and can't be looked up later.
newGallery.createdPublish: The link starts working once you publish the gallery.

gallery.openWarning: Anyone with the link can open this gallery. There is no passkey in front of it.
gallery.noCodeWarning: This gallery is private but has no working passkey, so nobody can open it.
gallery.notFoundBlurb: It may have been deleted, or the address is wrong.

photos.emptyBlurb: Uploading from the Studio is the next thing being built. Until then, put the files in this folder of the storage zone and run reseed and build-ladder as before. They will land in this gallery.
photos.coverHint: The cover is the photo shown first and on the gallery's tile.

settings.title: Title
settings.accentHint: Shown behind the photos while they load.
settings.clientNoteHint: Shown at the top of their gallery.
settings.listLabelHint: What the list on the site shows instead of the title. Leave it empty to use the title.
settings.closesOnHint: After this day the gallery stops opening. Leave it empty to keep it open.
settings.addressHint: It can't be changed here: links you already sent would stop working.
settings.publishedHint: When this is off, its page on the site says "not found". You still see the gallery here.
settings.listedHint: Everyone sees this list. A private gallery appears in it as a locked tile under its list name, or under its title when that is empty.
settings.tierOriginalHint: The untouched file, exactly as it was uploaded.
settings.deleteBlurb: Removes the gallery and its passkeys. This can't be undone.
settings.deleteBlocked: A gallery with photos can't be deleted from the Studio yet. That arrives together with storage cleanup.

access.privateHint: Clients type a code before they see anything.
access.publicHint: No code. Whoever has the address sees the photos.
access.makePublicConfirm: Yes, open it to anyone with the link
access.passkeysBlurb: Each person can have their own, and you can turn one off without touching the others. A code that is turned off no longer opens the gallery, but a browser that is already in stays in for up to {days} days. The code itself is never stored, so it can't be shown again.
access.codeHint: At least 6 characters. Capitals are safest: phones type capitals at the gate.
access.label: Who it is for
access.createdBlurb: Copy it now. It is shown only this once.

errors.failed: That didn't work and nothing was changed. Try again.
errors.notSetUp: The database is missing the Studio update. Run supabase/migrations/20261115100000_studio_gallery_writes.sql and try again.
errors.invalid: One of the values isn't accepted. Check the form and try again.
errors.titleLength: Give it a title, up to 200 characters.
errors.slugFormat: The address needs 2 to 60 lowercase Latin letters or digits, with single hyphens between words.
errors.slugTaken: That address is already taken. Change it a little.
errors.folderTaken: Another gallery already uses that storage folder. Change the address.
errors.categoryFormat: A category needs 2 to 40 Latin letters, digits or spaces.
errors.categoryReserved: That category name is reserved. Choose another.
errors.codeInUse: This gallery already has that passkey.
errors.tooManyCodes: A gallery can have 10 working passkeys. Turn one off first.
errors.labelLength: That name is too long, 80 characters at most.
errors.hasPhotos: This gallery has photos, so it can't be deleted here yet.

error.title: Something went wrong
error.blurb: The page could not be loaded. Nothing was changed.
